Name: Lightroom Presets
Author: keelan182

Actions.Name: Apply Lightroom Preset
Actions.Tooltip: Applies a chosen Lightroom Desktop/CC develop preset to the currently selected photo.

Actions.Name: Refresh Lightroom Presets
Actions.Tooltip: Re-discovers presets from Lightroom Desktop/CC and updates every button's cached preset list.

Actions.Name: Adjust Develop Setting
Actions.Tooltip: Turn a Stream Deck+ dial to adjust a Lightroom Develop setting (exposure, white balance, and more) on the selected photo.

TriggerDescription.Rotate: Adjust value (hold + rotate for a bigger step)

Actions.Name: Toggle Lens Correction
Actions.Tooltip: Turns a Lightroom lens correction setting on or off (lens profile corrections, chromatic aberration removal).

Actions.Name: Flag & Rate Photo
Actions.Tooltip: Flags, star-rates, or color-labels the currently selected photo in Lightroom.

Actions.Name: Develop Utility
Actions.Tooltip: Resets all Develop adjustments, or copies/pastes edit settings between photos.

Actions.Name: Copy Edit Settings
Actions.Tooltip: Copies the edit settings from the currently selected photo in Lightroom.

Actions.Name: Paste Edit Settings
Actions.Tooltip: Pastes the last-copied edit settings onto the currently selected photo in Lightroom.

Description: Control Adobe Lightroom Desktop/CC from Stream Deck: apply presets, adjust Develop settings with dials, toggle lens corrections, flag/rate photos, and more - via Lightroom's own External Controller API.
